claim_title: specificity / causally manipulable knob (repaired at clean dose alpha=8)

figures.caption: At the clean dose alpha=8, only the alpha-helix feature set raises helix (0.49->0.59) while lowering sheet; matched-control and beta-sheet off-target change neither -- the beta-sheet amplification arm is an honest negative (delta-sheet +0.005).

Specificity vs a genuine 33-direction random-null: the alpha-helix set's helix gain (+0.096) exceeds all 33 norm-matched random directions (0/33 >= S; p=0.029, z=3.0), with capability matched (valid-ORF 0.89 ~= 0.89).
